lessons.avoid: Making interface overlays look like a hardware display without explaining where they appear.
lessons.open: Capture provenance, display location, streaming setup, hardware limits and actual sound remain unverified.

comparison.story: Introduce moment capture through a memorable event. → Repeat the capture pattern across moments. → Introduce streaming. → Sustain the stream scenario. → Resolve the character story and repeat the product on another person. → Reveal hardware detail and purchase destination.
